message.name: SecuritiesAccountPositionResponseV01
message.definition: SCOPE|The SecuritiesAccountPositionResponse message is sent by a market infrastructure to an instructing party to report the securities positions for the given date period as requested in the query, for all securities across all accounts satisfying the query criteria.||USAGE|The message SecuritiesAccountPositionResponse will provide CSDs and T2S participants with a report corresponding to the SecuritiesAccountPositionQuery returning balances held in the list of specified securities accounts within the specified period satisfying the defined selection criteria. The Securities Account Position Response will provide the following business attributes:|-	CSD |-	Account owner|-	Securities Account Number|-	Securities Identifier (e.g. ISIN)|-	Date|-	The total position|-	The blocked position|-	The free position ||Unless otherwise specified by the sender in the Securities Balance Query, T2S will only return non-zero securities positions in the accounts.||The message may also be used to: ||- re-send a message previously sent (the sub-function of the message is Duplicate) ||- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy) ||- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy Duplicate).

rules.name: ReportNumberRule
rules.text: If the report has multiple pages, then the ReportNumber must remain the same through all the pages. It is a unique number to the report.|Two reports of the same type sent one after the other to the same receiver in relation to the same safekeeping account must have different ReportNumbers. For example, a daily report sent on day 1 would have ReportNumber 001, on day 2, 002, etc.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When an ISIN code exists, it is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: PlaceOfListingRule
rules.text: If PlaceOfListing is used and a ISO 10383 MIC exists for the market to be identified, the ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code (MIC) must be used.

rules.name: AdditionalDetailsRule
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if FinancialInstrumentAttributeAdditionalDetails is present, then it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: SafekeepingPlaceFormatOrLEIRule
rules.text: SafekeepingPlaceFormat must be present or LEI must be present.

rules.name: ValueRule
rules.text: If TypeOfPriceCode is not MRKT, then Value  may not be expressed with UnknownIndicator.

rules.name: EligibleCollateralValueRule
rules.text: EligibleCollateralValue is only to be used in (I)CSD-participant communication or if bilaterally agreed between the sender and receiver.

rules.name: SubBalanceAdditionalDetailsRule
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if SubBalanceAdditionnalDetails is used, them it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: EligibleForCollateralPurposesRule
rules.text: If Subbalance type is EligibleForCollateralPurposes, then QuantityAndAvailability cannot be used.

rules.name: SubBalanceAdditionalDetailsRule
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if SubBalanceAdditionnalDetails is used, them it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: AvailableWithNoStatusRule
rules.text: If Subbalance type is AvailableWithNoStatus, then QuantityAndAvailability cannot be used.

rules.name: SubBalanceAdditionalDetailsRule
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if SubBalanceAdditionnalDetails is used, them it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: EligibleForCollateralPurposesRule
rules.text: If Subbalance type is EligibleForCollateralPurposes, then QuantityAndAvailability cannot be used.

rules.name: PledgeeTypeAndIdentificationOrLEIRule
rules.text: PledgeeTypeAndIdentification must be present or LEI must be present.

rules.name: AggregateBalanceGuideline
rules.text: If AvailableQuantity and NotAvailableQuantity are both present, then the AggregateQuantity should be the sum of AvailableQuantity and NotAvailableQuantity.

rules.name: HoldingAdditionalDetailsRule
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if HoldingAdditionnalDetails is present, then it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: BalanceAtSafekeepingPlaceRule
rules.text: If SafekeepingPlace is present, then BalanceAtSafekeepingPlace is not allowed.

rules.name: AggregateBalanceGuideline
rules.text: If AvailableBalance and NotAvailableBalance are both present, then the AggregateBalance should be the sum of AvailableBalance and NotAvailableBalance.

rules.name: FinancialInstrumentAttributesRule
rules.text: If InvestmentFundsFinancialInstrumentAttributes is present, then FinancialInstrumentAttributes is not allowed.

rules.name: SubSafekeepingReportingRule
rules.text: Use of consolidated reports on a sub-safekeeping account must be bilaterally agreed between sender and receiver.

rules.name: ActivityAndBalanceForSubAccount1Rule
rules.text: If the ActivityIndicator is "true" (Yes), then at least one occurrence of BalanceForSubAccount must be present.

rules.name: ActivityAndBalanceForSubAccount2Rule
rules.text: If the ActivityIndicator is "false" (No), then BalanceForSubAccount must be absent.

rules.name: TotalEligibleCollateralValueRule
rules.text: Total eligible collateral value is only to be used in (I)CSD-participant communication or if bilaterally agreed between the sender and receiver.

rules.name: BalanceForAccountOrSubAccountRule
rules.text: BalanceForAccount must be present or SubAccountDetails must be present, both may be present.

rules.name: AdditonalDetailsGuideline
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, DeclarationlDetails, RegistrationDetails and PartyContactDetails must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: IdentificationNationalityOfInvestorRule
rules.text: Identification and/or Nationality must be present.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rule
rules.text: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rule
rules.text: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

rules.name: BalancePresenceRule
rules.text: If ReportGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is TRUE (Yes), then Balances must be present. If ReportGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is FALSE (No), then Balances must be absent.

rules.name: BalanceForAccountReportingRule
rules.text: If ReportGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is TRUE (Yes) and ReportGeneralDetails/SubAccountIndicator is FALSE (NO), then Balances/BalanceForAccount must be present and Balances/SubAccountDetails must be absent.

rules.name: SubAccountReportingRule
rules.text: If ReportGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is TRUE (Yes) and ReportGeneralDetails/SubAccountIndicator is TRUE (YES), then Balances/SubAccountDetails must be present and Balances/BalanceForAccount must be absent.
